// GREEN fixture for `no-cross-sync-cycle` — the EB-08 write-path leg (P-044). The lint MUST admit
// this. The merge-gate write path reads its OWN cell-local check_status PROJECTION (kept fresh via
// the bus) instead of synchronously calling CI — CI emits, Git reads (00-reconciliation §X-1). The
// cross-subsystem dependency is async over the bus, so the call graph stays acyclic (EI-02 §3).
// @write-path
pub async fn evaluate_merge_gate(projection: &CheckStatusProjection, commit_oid: &str) -> bool {
    // OK: read the local projection — no synchronous cross-subsystem call. The projection is fed by
    // CI's `ci.check.updated` / `ci.result` events via an idempotent EventHandler, never a sync RPC.
    projection.required_checks_green(commit_oid)
}
